name: nopa
description: Nopa: your people's voices, spread through your training sessions.

scripts.athlete:web: npm run athlete:build-web && node scripts/serve.mjs athlete/dist 8081
scripts.e2e: npm run athlete:build-web && playwright test --config e2e/playwright.config.mjs --trace off
scripts.athlete:build-web: cd athlete && EXPO_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL=http://127.0.0.1:54321 EXPO_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY=$(node -e "import(\"../e2e/local.mjs\").then(m=>console.log(m.ANON_KEY))") EXPO_PUBLIC_SUPPORTER_URL=http://localhost:8080 npx expo export --platform web --output-dir dist
scripts.athlete:publish-web: cd athlete && set -a && . ./.env.hosted && set +a && EXPO_BASE_URL=/nopa/app npx expo export --platform web --output-dir ../app
